description: An unlink — a later SetEdgeExistenceInterval that closes the edge's open-ended existence with a finite valid_to — makes the edge absent after the unlink instant. Before that instant the edge is still visible.

expected.deciding_rule: latest asserted time then containment (closed existence interval excludes the instant)

superseded.reason: the open-ended existence was superseded by op-0911's closed interval [2026-01-01, 2026-05-01), which excludes 2026-06-11

expected.note: A read at an instant before 2026-05-01 (e.g. 2026-03-01) would find the edge visible under op-0911's interval; a read pinned to a belief before op-0911 would resolve op-0910's open-ended edge.
